description: This Dart source file defines the BoardProvider class which manages the state and mechanics for a Snakes & Ladders game in a Flutter application. It handles the player's position, dice rolling, and interactions with snakes and ladders on the board.

classes.name: BoardProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class responsible for managing the game state of a Snakes & Ladders game, including player position, dice mechanics, and snake/ladder interactions.

methods.name: enableDice
methods.description: Enables the dice to be rolled, typically after a focus session is completed.

methods.name: resetToStart
methods.description: Resets the game board to the starting position and disables dice rolling.

methods.name: rollDiceAndMove
methods.description: Rolls a six-sided dice, updates the player's position including snakes/ladders, and disables further dice rolls until re-enabled.

methods.name: _moveBy
methods.description: Internal method to move the player by a given number of steps and apply snakes or ladders.

methods.name: rewardRandomLadder
methods.description: Provides a bonus by moving the player up a random ladder or moving forward by 3 if no suitable ladder is found.
